title: Spring 2026 Finals Matches
body:
Finals matches have been loaded into [DartConnect](https://my.dartconnect.com/league/schedule/scvda/21709)! Come out and support on June 11:

A: Trippin' Bulls @ Never A Doubt (Duke of Edinburgh)
B: After Party @ Last Call Legends (Beefy's Cabin)
C: Dart Vaders @ Starving Dartists (Court's Lounge)

title: Spring 2026 Playoffs and Banquet
body:
Semifinal matches (June 4) have been loaded into [DartConnect](https://my.dartconnect.com/league/schedule/scvda/21709)!

Finals are on June 11.

The banquet will be June 18 at Beefy's!

title: Spring 2026 season underway
body: May 21 will be the last regular season match for B division. May 28 will be the last regular season match for A and C divisions.

title: Spring Season starts today!
body: Welcome to Week 1 of Spring 2026. Don't forget to submit pictures of your scoresheets after your match.
